description: This file defines Flask application context management, including classes and functions for handling app and request contexts, global data storage, and context pushing/popping mechanisms.

classes.name: _AppCtxGlobals
classes.description: A namespace object for storing application-wide data during an app context.

classes.name: AppContext
classes.description: Represents an application context, managing request and app data, routing, and lifecycle.

methods.name: after_this_request
methods.description: Decorator to register a function to run after the current request.

methods.name: copy_current_request_context
methods.description: Decorator to run a function within the current request context, useful for background tasks.

methods.name: has_request_context
methods.description: Checks if a request context is active.

methods.name: has_app_context
methods.description: Checks if an app context is active.
